description: Design shareable 1080×1080 quote cards: your quote and author, six styled themes, live preview, and a real PNG download.

faqs.a: The card renders at 1080×1080 pixels — the standard square size for Instagram and Facebook posts.
faqs.q: What size is the exported card?

faqs.a: Type the quote and author, pick a theme, and the preview updates instantly. Download when it looks right.
faqs.q: How do I make a card?

faqs.a: Long quotes wrap automatically across multiple lines; keep it under ~200 characters for the best typography.
faqs.q: What if my quote is long?

howto: Type your quote and the author's name.
Pick one of the six themes.
Click "Download PNG" to save the card.
title: Quote Card Maker
